help.name: /name <new>     change your name
help.codes: codes: ko en zh ja vi fr de es ru id pt
help.phone: /phone [new]    show the phone address; new = new token
help.enter: Enter           send or run a command
help.ctrl_p: Ctrl+P          show or hide the phone address
usage.name: usage: /name <new name>   (or press Ctrl+N)
peers.none_hint: no peers yet. Start herdr-talk on another PC on the same network.
start.hello: herdr-talk: you are '{name}' (TCP port {port}). Type /help for commands.
open.no_pane: herdr-talk open: run this from a herdr pane (HERDR_PANE_ID is not set).
usage.trust: usage: /join <code>   (the code shown on the other PC)
trust.done: trusted {name} at {ip}. Messages to them are now encrypted.
trust.none: no unverified peer has the code {code}
trust.save_failed: trusted for this session only, could not save: {error}
peer.unverified: not sent to {name}: not verified yet. Compare codes, then /join
peer.plain_off: not sent to {name}: they do not encrypt, and plain text is off
peer.key_changed: {name} at {ip} has a new key. Not trusted, nothing sent. Use /join only if you know why
peer.kicked: {name} at {ip} was removed: not joined within 20 seconds. Not admitted again in this chat.
trust.ambiguous: several different keys match code {code}. Not trusted: compare the codes again
phone.title: Phone address (shown on this screen only):
phone.hint: Ctrl+P or any key hides this. /phone new makes a new token.
phone.none: No phone address yet: no host on this PC.
phone.new_done: New token made. Phones must enter the new one.
mode.hint_local: Chat over the LAN only. Nothing is sent to Supabase.
mode.hint_supabase: Chat through Supabase only. Messages do not go over the LAN.
mode.first_run_title: How do you want to connect?
relay.not_sent: relay: not connected, the message was not sent over the relay
settings.code_ok: setup code accepted and saved: fill in the rest, then press Enter on the last row
settings.ctrl_s_only_code: F2 saves in the setup-code row only
settings.code_invalid: setup code must be 8 letters or digits
settings.need_code: Not saved. Type the setup code first
settings.save_ok_local: Saved: local mode. The relay is stopped.
settings.save_ok_supabase: Saved: Supabase mode. The relay is started.
peer.old_version: {name} ({ip}): this is an old version, so it cannot be verified. Update both PCs to the new version
trust.wrong_code: {name}: a different confirmation value arrived. The connection was refused
room.only_one: Only one room per PC: this PC already uses room {code}
trust.no_number: no waiting peer has the number {n}
trust.already: {n} is already verified, or is no longer waiting
form.title: SUPABASE SETTINGS
form.hint_code: Type the setup code, then F2: the URL and key are saved (not shown)
form.hint_room: Join: type a room ID here, then Enter  ·  New room: press Ctrl+N
form.operator_hint: operator passphrase: Enter issues a setup code, Esc cancels
form.footer: Tab: next · Enter: next / save · Ctrl+N: create room · F3: language · Esc: CANCEL
form.room_need_supabase: create room: switch to Supabase mode first
form.room_no_keys: create room: this PC has no keys yet (start a chat first)
form.room_need_save: create room: save the setup code and the display name first
form.room_trust: create room: the trust code must be 8 digits
form.room_created: room created: {value} (save with Enter to apply)
form.issued: new setup code: {value} (20 uses, 7 days; write it down now)
form.publish_network: this PC's row could not be published (network or server error)
form.publish_taken: this PC's short id is already used by another key (409). Try again
form.publish_status: this PC's row could not be published (status {status})
first.hint: 1 / 2, or Tab then Enter · F3: language · Esc: quit
